title: Vanilla Rewired
description: Vanilla Rewired improves performance and shader support while keeping the vanilla Minecraft feel intact.
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40b35c10028a29fb0e5847ebed75fce6dd3047c0.png)

Vanilla Rewired is a carefully crafted modpack focused on improving the performance, stability, and overall quality of Minecraft while preserving the true vanilla experience. Instead of changing the core gameplay with major content additions or gameplay overhauls, Vanilla Rewired enhances what already makes Minecraft enjoyable by making the game smoother, faster, and more responsive.

The modpack includes a collection of optimization and quality-of-life mods designed to increase FPS, reduce lag, improve loading times, and enhance general game stability across a wide range of systems. It also adds subtle improvements to the user experience without affecting the familiar feel, progression, mechanics, or balance of vanilla Minecraft.

Vanilla Rewired is perfect for players who want better performance and a cleaner experience without losing the charm and simplicity of the original game. Whether you are exploring, building, surviving, or playing with friends, the goal of Vanilla Rewired is to make Minecraft feel like vanilla — just better optimized.

## Included Mods

Vanilla Rewired features a curated selection of performance and quality-of-life mods, including:

Axiom
Sodium
Better Block Entities
ImmediatelyFast

…and many more carefully selected mods that improve performance, visuals, and overall smoothness while keeping the gameplay experience true to vanilla Minecraft.

# Features
Improved FPS and overall game performance
You should get 100-200 more fps
Faster chunk loading and reduced lag spikes
Better memory usage and game stability
Optimized rendering for smoother gameplay
Lightweight quality-of-life improvements
Maintains the authentic vanilla Minecraft feel
Multiplayer-friendly and survival-focused

Whether you play on low-end hardware or simply want the smoothest vanilla-style Minecraft experience possible, Vanilla Rewired is designed to deliver a polished and optimized adventure without unnecessary complexity.
